transcript.assistant: Welcome! I'm EMBassador, your personal guide to EMBA, IEMBA and emba X at HSG. I'm here to answer your questions and help you explore your EMBA options.

transcript.user: Hi, I'm looking for an MBA program in Switzerland with international focus.
transcript.assistant:
For an **international focus**, the **International Executive MBA HSG (IEMBA HSG)** is the most direct match: it is taught in English, includes **four weeks abroad** and brings together an internationally diverse cohort. It starts **30 August 2027**, lasts **18 months**, and the current fee is **CHF 84,000** for applications by **31 March 2027** (then CHF 89,000 by the final deadline of 30 June 2027). [Programme details](https://emba.unisg.ch/en/programm/iemba)

Two other Executive MBA options in Switzerland may also be relevant:

- **emba X** is taught in English and combines international management with technology, innovation and leadership. It is an 18-month blended programme in Zurich, St.Gallen and online. The current cohort’s fee is **CHF 110,000**; its application window (31 August–31 October 2026) is closed. The programme advisor can provide information on the next window. [emba X website](https://embax.ch/)
- **EMBA HSG** is taught in German, with a focus on the German-speaking region. It starts **8 March 2027**, lasts **18 months**, and the current fee is **CHF 72,500** for applications by **23 November 2026** (then CHF 77,500 by 1 February 2027). [Programme details](https://emba.unisg.ch/en/programm/emba)

All three are Executive MBA programmes designed for experienced professionals. IEMBA HSG appears the closest match if you want an English-language programme with international modules and a global cohort.

transcript.user: I'm from the US. What about visa requirements?
transcript.assistant: For visa and permit questions, please contact our admissions team at **emba@unisg.ch** or **+41 71 224 27 02**.

transcript.user: How strong is the alumni network in Asia-Pacific?
transcript.assistant: The **IEMBA HSG** is internationally oriented, and its curriculum includes modules in **Tokyo and Beijing**. However, published information does not specify the size or distribution of its alumni network in Asia-Pacific, or whether it has active regional chapters. So I can’t substantiate how strong the network is specifically in that region. For current details on alumni presence and connections there, contact IEMBA advisor Kristin Fuchs at **kristin.fuchs@unisg.ch** or **+41 71 224 75 46**.

The **International Executive MBA HSG** costs **CHF 84,000** if you apply by **31 March 2027**. The fee is **CHF 89,000** for applications submitted by the final deadline, **30 June 2027**. Travel and accommodation for programme modules, including those abroad, are additional costs.

transcript.user: Can you assess whether I am eligible?
transcript.assistant:
For the **International Executive MBA HSG**, the published application criteria are a recognised undergraduate degree, at least **five years of professional experience**, at least **three years in a managerial or leadership role**, and fluency in English. Applicants should also be employed when applying and remain employed during the programme. Admission without a recognised undergraduate degree may be considered **sur dossier**, based on an individual assessment.

I can compare your profile with these criteria if you share whether you hold a recognised degree, your total years of work experience, and how many years you have held a leadership role. The admissions committee makes the final decision. For an individual assessment, contact IEMBA advisor Kristin Fuchs at **kristin.fuchs@unisg.ch** or **+41 71 224 75 46**. The [admissions process](https://emba.unisg.ch/en/admissions/process) is also available online.
